versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Elihu also continued, and said,
controles.kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
controles.livre: Prosseguiu Eliú ainda, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃

controles.web: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
controles.kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
controles.livre: Espera-me um pouco, e eu te mostrarei que ainda há palavras a favor de Deus.

versos.hebraico: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃

controles.web: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
controles.kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
controles.livre: Desde longe trarei meu conhecimento, e a meu Criador atribuirei a justiça.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
controles.kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
controles.livre: Porque verdadeiramente minhas palavras não serão falsas; contigo está um que tem completo conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃

controles.web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
controles.kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
controles.livre: Eis que Deus é grande, porém despreza ninguém; grande ele é em poder de entendimento.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

controles.web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives to the afflicted their right.
controles.kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
controles.livre: Ele não permite o perverso viver, e faz justiça aos aflitos.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
controles.kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
controles.livre: Ele não tira seus olhos do justo; ao contrário, ele os faz sentar com os reis no trono, e assim são exaltados.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

controles.web: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
controles.kjv: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
controles.livre: E se estiverem presos em grilhões, e detidos com cordas de aflição,

versos.hebraico: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
controles.kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
controles.livre: Então ele lhes faz saber as obras que fizeram, e suas transgressões, das quais se orgulharam.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃

controles.web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
controles.kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
controles.livre: E revela a seus ouvidos, para que sejam disciplinados; e lhes diz, para que se convertam da maldade.

versos.hebraico: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃

controles.web: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
controles.kjv: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
controles.livre: Se ouvirem, e o servirem, acabarão seus dias em prosperidade, e seus anos em prazeres.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: But if they don’t listen, they shall perish by the sword; they shall die without knowledge.
controles.kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
controles.livre: Porém se não ouvirem, perecerão pela espada, e morrerão sem conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃

controles.web: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
controles.kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
controles.livre: E os hipócritas de coração acumulam a ira divina ; e quando ele os amarrar, mesmo assim não clamam.

versos.hebraico: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
controles.kjv: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
controles.livre: A alma deles morrerá em sua juventude, e sua vida entre os pervertidos.

versos.hebraico: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃

controles.web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
controles.kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
controles.livre: Ele livra o aflito de sua aflição, e na opressão ele revela a seus ouvidos.

versos.hebraico: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨׀ מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a broad place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
controles.kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
controles.livre: Assim também ele pode te desviar da boca da angústia para um lugar amplo, onde não haveria aperto; para o conforto de tua mesa, cheia dos melhores alimentos.

versos.hebraico: וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

controles.web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
controles.kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
controles.livre: Mas tu estás cheio do julgamento do perverso; o julgamento e a justiça te tomam.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃

controles.web: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
controles.kjv: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
controles.livre: Por causa da furor, guarda-te para que não sejas seduzido pela riqueza, nem que um grande suborno  te faça desviar.

versos.hebraico: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃

controles.web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
controles.kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
controles.livre: Pode, por acaso, a tua riqueza  te sustentar para que não tenhas aflição, mesmo com todos os esforços de teu poder?

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

controles.web: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
controles.kjv: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
controles.livre: Não anseies pela noite, em que os povos são tomados de seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃

controles.web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
controles.kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
controles.livre: Guarda-te, e não te voltes para a maldade; pois por isto que tens sido testado com miséria.

versos.hebraico: הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
controles.kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
controles.livre: Eis que Deus é exaltado em seu poder; que instrutor há como ele?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

controles.web: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
controles.kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
controles.livre: Quem lhe indica o seu caminho? Quem poderá lhe dizer: Cometeste maldade?

versos.hebraico: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: “Remember that you magnify his work, whereof men have sung.
controles.kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
controles.livre: Lembra-te de engrandeceres sua obra, a qual os seres humanos contemplam.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

controles.web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
controles.kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
controles.livre: Todas as pessoas a veem; o ser humano a enxerga de longe.

versos.hebraico: הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃

controles.web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
controles.kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
controles.livre: Eis que Deus é grande, e nós não o compreendemos; não se pode descobrir o número de seus anos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
controles.kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
controles.livre: Ele traz para cima as gotas das águas, que derramam a chuva de seu vapor;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃

controles.web: Which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
controles.kjv: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
controles.livre: A qual as nuvens destilam, gotejando abundantemente sobre o ser humano.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
controles.kjv: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
controles.livre: Poderá alguém entender a extensão das nuvens, e os estrondos de seu pavilhão?

versos.hebraico: הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
controles.kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
controles.livre: Eis que estende sobre ele sua luz, e cobre as profundezas  do mar.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃

controles.web: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
controles.kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
controles.livre: Pois por estas coisas ele julga aos povos, e dá alimento em abundância.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃

controles.web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
controles.kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
controles.livre: Ele cobre as mãos com o relâmpago, e dá ordens para que atinja o alvo.

versos.hebraico: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עוֹלֶֽה׃

controles.web: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
controles.kjv: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
controles.livre: O trovão anuncia sua presença; o gado também prenuncia a tempestade que se aproxima.
